existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: R6 `Subscription` is a major local redesign with hard R4→R6 validation breaks. The top concerns are required `criteria`/`channel` removal with new required `topic`/`channelType`, non-trivial criteria-to-topic/filter migration, and payload/header/status semantics that affect runtime delivery. The main uncertainty is the lack of official cross-version mapping and full terminology expansion for all related value sets.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration should be treated as a redesign exercise: map R4 criteria to `SubscriptionTopic` plus `filterBy`, flatten and retype channel settings, decide payload content policies, convert headers to structured parameters, and plan where operational status/error state lives. Reverse R6→R4 conversion is lossy for topic, structured filters, `Coding` channel types, id-only payloads, new status code `entered-in-error`, optional R6 management fields, and R6 instances omitting `reason`.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for structural, cardinality, datatype, binding-reference, and local CodeSystem differences because both StructureDefinitions and local terminology files were inspected. Confidence is medium for intended migration semantics and exact channel-type code equivalence because official diffs, narrative migration guidance, live terminology expansions, and Subscription-specific cross-version maps were not available locally.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
Subscription keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 2 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 4 potential hard break(s), 3 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 2 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 3, which creates meaningful stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 47/100, producing migration shape `moderate-targeted-remodel`, major migration `Partial`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

1 finding(s) identify a yes/partial less-breaking base-design alternative, so the aggregate should not be used to dismiss local avoidability review.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: Inline R4 criteria was replaced by a mandatory SubscriptionTopic reference and topic-scoped filters
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: a valid R4 instance has `criteria` and no `topic`, while a base R6 instance requires `topic` and has no `criteria`; generated APIs and criteria readers also need redesign.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R4 channel backbone was flattened and channel.type changed from primitive code to Coding
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: the required R4 `channel` object is not an R6 Subscription element and R4 instances lack required `channelType`; codegen changes from a nested primitive code to a top-level Coding.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Payload configuration split into contentType and content level, changing no-payload and partial-payload semantics
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: runtime/API/codegen: populated R4 `channel.payload` must move to `contentType` and may need a content-level policy; R6 `content=id-only` also creates R6-to-R4 loss because R4 has no native id-only payload mode.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Free-form channel headers became structured channel parameters with required name and value
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: runtime/API/codegen: R4 string headers must be parsed into name/value components and R6 generated models require a backbone component; this is only an old-valid/new-invalid issue for instances that actually populate headers.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Subscription.error was removed from Subscription and error reporting appears to move to SubscriptionStatus
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 Subscription carrying `error` is not valid as an R6 Subscription without transformation; R6-to-R4 conversion of repeatable coded errors to one string is lossy.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 filterBy introduces mandatory child fields and a new comparator/modifier mutual-exclusion invariant
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: none: the invariant applies only when R6 `filterBy` is populated; invalid migrated filters are a conversion-tooling problem tied to the separate criteria replacement.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Subscription.status required value set adds entered-in-error, widening a modifier element's code domain
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: an R6 `entered-in-error` status has no native R4 code; there is no old-valid/new-invalid break for R4 status values.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
